150: void FBXExporter::ExportBinary (
151:     const char* pFile,
152:     IOSystem* pIOSystem
153: ){
154:     // remember that we're exporting in binary mode
155:     binary = true;
156: 
157:     // we're not currently using these preferences,
158:     // but clang will cry about it if we never touch it.
159:     // TODO: some of these might be relevant to export
160:     (void)mProperties;
161: 
162:     // open the indicated file for writing (in binary mode)
163:     outfile.reset(pIOSystem->Open(pFile,"wb"));
164:     if (!outfile) {
165:         throw DeadlyExportError(
166:             "could not open output .fbx file: " + std::string(pFile)
167:         );
168:     }
169: 
170:     // first a binary-specific file header
171:     WriteBinaryHeader();
172: 
173:     // the rest of the file is in node entries.
174:     // we have to serialize each entry before we write to the output,
175:     // as the first thing we write is the byte offset of the _next_ entry.
176:     // Either that or we can skip back to write the offset when we finish.
177:     WriteAllNodes();
178: 
179:     // finally we have a binary footer to the file
180:     WriteBinaryFooter();
181: 
182:     // explicitly release file pointer,
183:     // so we don't have to rely on class destruction.
184:     outfile.reset();
185: }

187: void FBXExporter::ExportAscii (
188:     const char* pFile,
189:     IOSystem* pIOSystem
190: ){
191:     // remember that we're exporting in ascii mode
192:     binary = false;
193: 
194:     // open the indicated file for writing in text mode
195:     outfile.reset(pIOSystem->Open(pFile,"wt"));
196:     if (!outfile) {
197:         throw DeadlyExportError(
198:             "could not open output .fbx file: " + std::string(pFile)
199:         );
200:     }
201: 
202:     // write the ascii header
203:     WriteAsciiHeader();
204: 
205:     // write all the sections
206:     WriteAllNodes();
207: 
208:     // make sure the file ends with a newline.
209:     // note: if the file is opened in text mode,
210:     // this should do the right cross-platform thing.
211:     outfile->Write("\n", 1, 1);
212: 
213:     // explicitly release file pointer,
214:     // so we don't have to rely on class destruction.
215:     outfile.reset();
216: }

218: void FBXExporter::WriteAsciiHeader()
219: {
220:     // basically just a comment at the top of the file
221:     std::stringstream head;
222:     head << "; FBX " << EXPORT_VERSION_STR << " project file\n";
223:     head << "; Created by the Open Asset Import Library (Assimp)\n";
224:     head << "; http://assimp.org\n";
225:     head << "; -------------------------------------------------\n";
226:     const std::string ascii_header = head.str();
227:     outfile->Write(ascii_header.c_str(), ascii_header.size(), 1);

239: void FBXExporter::WriteBinaryHeader()
240: {
241:     // first a specific sequence of 23 bytes, always the same
242:     const char binary_header[24] = "Kaydara FBX Binary\x20\x20\x00\x1a\x00";
243:     outfile->Write(binary_header, 1, 23);
244: 
245:     // then FBX version number, "multiplied" by 1000, as little-endian uint32.
246:     // so 7.3 becomes 7300 == 0x841C0000, 7.4 becomes 7400 == 0xE81C0000, etc
247:     {
248:         StreamWriterLE outstream(outfile);
249:         outstream.PutU4(EXPORT_VERSION_INT);
250:     } // StreamWriter destructor writes the data to the file
251: 
252:     // after this the node data starts immediately
253:     // (probably with the FBXHEaderExtension node)
254: }
255: 
256: void FBXExporter::WriteBinaryFooter()
257: {
258:     outfile->Write(NULL_RECORD, NumNullRecords, 1);
259: 
260:     outfile->Write(GENERIC_FOOTID.c_str(), GENERIC_FOOTID.size(), 1);
261: 
262:     // here some padding is added for alignment to 16 bytes.
263:     // if already aligned, the full 16 bytes is added.
264:     size_t pos = outfile->Tell();
265:     size_t pad = 16 - (pos % 16);
266:     for (size_t i = 0; i < pad; ++i) {
267:         outfile->Write("\x00", 1, 1);
268:     }
269: 
270:     // not sure what this is, but it seems to always be 0 in modern files
271:     for (size_t i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
272:         outfile->Write("\x00", 1, 1);
273:     }
274: 
275:     // now the file version again
276:     {
277:         StreamWriterLE outstream(outfile);
278:         outstream.PutU4(EXPORT_VERSION_INT);
279:     } // StreamWriter destructor writes the data to the file
280: 
281:     // and finally some binary footer added to all files
282:     for (size_t i = 0; i < 120; ++i) {
283:         outfile->Write("\x00", 1, 1);
284:     }
285:     outfile->Write(FOOT_MAGIC.c_str(), FOOT_MAGIC.size(), 1);
286: }

315: //FBXHeaderExtension top-level node
316: void FBXExporter::WriteHeaderExtension ()
317: {
318:     if (!binary) {
319:         // no title, follows directly from the top comment
320:     }
321:     FBX::Node n("FBXHeaderExtension");
322:     StreamWriterLE outstream(outfile);
323:     int indent = 0;
324: 
325:     // begin node
326:     n.Begin(outstream, binary, indent);
327: 
328:     // write properties
329:     // (none)
330: 
331:     // finish properties
332:     n.EndProperties(outstream, binary, indent, 0);
333: 
334:     // begin children
335:     n.BeginChildren(outstream, binary, indent);
336: 
337:     indent = 1;
338: 
339:     // write child nodes
340:     FBX::Node::WritePropertyNode(
341:         "FBXHeaderVersion", int32_t(1003), outstream, binary, indent
342:     );
343:     FBX::Node::WritePropertyNode(
344:         "FBXVersion", int32_t(EXPORT_VERSION_INT), outstream, binary, indent
345:     );
346:     if (binary) {
347:         FBX::Node::WritePropertyNode(
348:             "EncryptionType", int32_t(0), outstream, binary, indent
349:         );
350:     }
351: 
352:     FBX::Node CreationTimeStamp("CreationTimeStamp");
353:     time_t rawtime;
354:     time(&rawtime);
355:     struct tm * now = localtime(&rawtime);
356:     CreationTimeStamp.AddChild("Version", int32_t(1000));
357:     CreationTimeStamp.AddChild("Year", int32_t(now->tm_year + 1900));
358:     CreationTimeStamp.AddChild("Month", int32_t(now->tm_mon + 1));
359:     CreationTimeStamp.AddChild("Day", int32_t(now->tm_mday));
360:     CreationTimeStamp.AddChild("Hour", int32_t(now->tm_hour));
361:     CreationTimeStamp.AddChild("Minute", int32_t(now->tm_min));
362:     CreationTimeStamp.AddChild("Second", int32_t(now->tm_sec));
363:     CreationTimeStamp.AddChild("Millisecond", int32_t(0));
364:     CreationTimeStamp.Dump(outstream, binary, indent);
365: 
366:     std::stringstream creator;
367:     creator << "Open Asset Import Library (Assimp) " << aiGetVersionMajor()
368:             << "." << aiGetVersionMinor() << "." << aiGetVersionRevision();
369:     FBX::Node::WritePropertyNode(
370:         "Creator", creator.str(), outstream, binary, indent
371:     );
372: 
373:     indent = 0;
374: 
375:     // finish node
376:     n.End(outstream, binary, indent, true);
377: 
378:     // that's it for FBXHeaderExtension...
379:     if (!binary) { return; }
380: 
381:     // but binary files also need top-level FileID, CreationTime, Creator:
382:     std::vector<uint8_t> raw(GENERIC_FILEID.size());
383:     for (size_t i = 0; i < GENERIC_FILEID.size(); ++i) {
384:         raw[i] = uint8_t(GENERIC_FILEID[i]);
385:     }
386:     FBX::Node::WritePropertyNode(
387:         "FileId", std::move(raw), outstream, binary, indent
388:     );
389:     FBX::Node::WritePropertyNode(
390:         "CreationTime", GENERIC_CTIME, outstream, binary, indent
391:     );
392:     FBX::Node::WritePropertyNode(
393:         "Creator", creator.str(), outstream, binary, indent
394:     );
395: }

528: // some internal helper functions used for writing the definitions
529: // (before any actual data is written)

531: size_t count_nodes(const aiNode* n, const aiNode* root) {
532:     size_t count;
533:     if (n == root) {
534:         count = n->mNumMeshes; // (not counting root node)
535:     } else if (n->mNumMeshes > 1) {
536:         count = n->mNumMeshes + 1;
537:     } else {
538:         count = 1;
539:     }
540:     for (size_t i = 0; i < n->mNumChildren; ++i) {
541:         count += count_nodes(n->mChildren[i], root);
542:     }
543:     return count;
544: }

546: static bool has_phong_mat(const aiScene* scene) {
547:     // just search for any material with a shininess exponent
548:     for (size_t i = 0; i < scene->mNumMaterials; ++i) {
549:         aiMaterial* mat = scene->mMaterials[i];
550:         float shininess = 0;
551:         mat->Get(AI_MATKEY_SHININESS, shininess);
552:         if (shininess > 0) {
553:             return true;
554:         }
555:     }
556:     return false;
557: }
558: 
559: static size_t count_images(const aiScene* scene) {
560:     std::unordered_set<std::string> images;
561:     aiString texpath;
562:     for (size_t i = 0; i < scene->mNumMaterials; ++i) {
563:         aiMaterial *mat = scene->mMaterials[i];
564:         for (size_t tt = aiTextureType_DIFFUSE; tt < aiTextureType_UNKNOWN; ++tt) {
565:             const aiTextureType textype = static_cast<aiTextureType>(tt);
566:             const size_t texcount = mat->GetTextureCount(textype);
567:             for (unsigned int j = 0; j < texcount; ++j) {
568:                 mat->GetTexture(textype, j, &texpath);
569:                 images.insert(std::string(texpath.C_Str()));
570:             }
571:         }
572:     }
573: 
574:     return images.size();
575: }
576: 
577: static size_t count_textures(const aiScene* scene) {
578:     size_t count = 0;
579:     for (size_t i = 0; i < scene->mNumMaterials; ++i) {
580:         aiMaterial* mat = scene->mMaterials[i];
581:         for (
582:             size_t tt = aiTextureType_DIFFUSE;
583:             tt < aiTextureType_UNKNOWN;
584:             ++tt
585:         ){
586:             // TODO: handle layered textures
587:             if (mat->GetTextureCount(static_cast<aiTextureType>(tt)) > 0) {
588:                 count += 1;
589:             }
590:         }
591:     }
592:     return count;
593: }
594: 
595: static size_t count_deformers(const aiScene* scene) {
596:     size_t count = 0;
597:     for (size_t i = 0; i < scene->mNumMeshes; ++i) {
598:         const size_t n = scene->mMeshes[i]->mNumBones;
599:         if (n) {
600:             // 1 main deformer, 1 subdeformer per bone
601:             count += n + 1;
602:         }
603:     }
604:     return count;
605: }

607: void FBXExporter::WriteDefinitions () {
608:     // basically this is just bookkeeping:
609:     // determining how many of each type of object there are
610:     // and specifying the base properties to use when otherwise unspecified.
611: 
612:     // ascii section header
613:     if (!binary) {
614:         WriteAsciiSectionHeader("Object definitions");
615:     }
616: 
617:     // we need to count the objects
618:     int32_t count;
619:     int32_t total_count = 0;
620: 
621:     // and store them
622:     std::vector<FBX::Node> object_nodes;
623:     FBX::Node n, pt, p;
624: 
625:     // GlobalSettings
626:     // this seems to always be here in Maya exports
627:     n = FBX::Node("ObjectType", "GlobalSettings");
628:     count = 1;
629:     n.AddChild("Count", count);
630:     object_nodes.push_back(n);
631:     total_count += count;
632: 
633:     // AnimationStack / FbxAnimStack
634:     // this seems to always be here in Maya exports,
635:     // but no harm seems to come of leaving it out.
636:     count = mScene->mNumAnimations;
637:     if (count) {
638:         n = FBX::Node("ObjectType", "AnimationStack");
639:         n.AddChild("Count", count);
640:         pt = FBX::Node("PropertyTemplate", "FbxAnimStack");
641:         p = FBX::Node("Properties70");
642:         p.AddP70string("Description", "");
643:         p.AddP70time("LocalStart", 0);
644:         p.AddP70time("LocalStop", 0);
645:         p.AddP70time("ReferenceStart", 0);
646:         p.AddP70time("ReferenceStop", 0);
647:         pt.AddChild(p);
648:         n.AddChild(pt);
649:         object_nodes.push_back(n);
650:         total_count += count;
651:     }
652: 
653:     // AnimationLayer / FbxAnimLayer
654:     // this seems to always be here in Maya exports,
655:     // but no harm seems to come of leaving it out.
656:     // Assimp doesn't support animation layers,
657:     // so there will be one per aiAnimation
658:     count = mScene->mNumAnimations;
659:     if (count) {
660:         n = FBX::Node("ObjectType", "AnimationLayer");
661:         n.AddChild("Count", count);
662:         pt = FBX::Node("PropertyTemplate", "FBXAnimLayer");
663:         p = FBX::Node("Properties70");
664:         p.AddP70("Weight", "Number", "", "A", double(100));
665:         p.AddP70bool("Mute", false);
666:         p.AddP70bool("Solo", false);
667:         p.AddP70bool("Lock", false);
668:         p.AddP70color("Color", 0.8, 0.8, 0.8);
669:         p.AddP70("BlendMode", "enum", "", "", int32_t(0));
670:         p.AddP70("RotationAccumulationMode", "enum", "", "", int32_t(0));
671:         p.AddP70("ScaleAccumulationMode", "enum", "", "", int32_t(0));
672:         p.AddP70("BlendModeBypass", "ULongLong", "", "", int64_t(0));
673:         pt.AddChild(p);
674:         n.AddChild(pt);
675:         object_nodes.push_back(n);
676:         total_count += count;
677:     }
678: 
679:     // NodeAttribute
680:     // this is completely absurd.
681:     // there can only be one "NodeAttribute" template,
682:     // but FbxSkeleton, FbxCamera, FbxLight all are "NodeAttributes".
683:     // so if only one exists we should set the template for that,
684:     // otherwise... we just pick one :/.
685:     // the others have to set all their properties every instance,
686:     // because there's no template.
687:     count = 1; // TODO: select properly

1018: static aiNode* get_node_for_mesh(unsigned int meshIndex, aiNode* node) {
1019:     for (size_t i = 0; i < node->mNumMeshes; ++i) {
1020:         if (node->mMeshes[i] == meshIndex) {
1021:             return node;
1022:         }
1023:     }
1024:     for (size_t i = 0; i < node->mNumChildren; ++i) {
1025:         aiNode* ret = get_node_for_mesh(meshIndex, node->mChildren[i]);
1026:         if (ret) { return ret; }
1027:     }
1028:     return nullptr;
1029: }

1031: aiMatrix4x4 get_world_transform(const aiNode* node, const aiScene* scene) {
1032:     std::vector<const aiNode*> node_chain;
1033:     while (node != scene->mRootNode && node != nullptr) {
1034:         node_chain.push_back(node);
1035:         node = node->mParent;
1036:     }
1037:     aiMatrix4x4 transform;
1038:     for (auto n = node_chain.rbegin(); n != node_chain.rend(); ++n) {
1039:         transform *= (*n)->mTransformation;
1040:     }
1041:     return transform;
1042: }

1047:     }
1048:     return (static_cast<int64_t>(ticks / anim->mTicksPerSecond)) * FBX::SECOND;
1049: }

1055: void FBXExporter::WriteObjects () {
1056:     if (!binary) {
1057:         WriteAsciiSectionHeader("Object properties");
1058:     }
1059:     // numbers should match those given in definitions! make sure to check
1060:     StreamWriterLE outstream(outfile);
1061:     FBX::Node object_node("Objects");
1062:     int indent = 0;
1063:     object_node.Begin(outstream, binary, indent);
1064:     object_node.EndProperties(outstream, binary, indent);
1065:     object_node.BeginChildren(outstream, binary, indent);
1066: 
1067:     bool bJoinIdenticalVertices = mProperties->GetPropertyBool("bJoinIdenticalVertices", true);
1068:     // save vertex_indices as it is needed later
1069:     std::vector<std::vector<int32_t>> vVertexIndice(mScene->mNumMeshes);
1070: 
1071:     std::vector<uint32_t> uniq_v_before_mi;
1072: 
1073:     const auto bTransparencyFactorReferencedToOpacity = mProperties->GetPropertyBool(AI_CONFIG_EXPORT_FBX_TRANSPARENCY_FACTOR_REFER_TO_OPACITY, false);
1074: 
1075:     // geometry (aiMesh)
1076:     mesh_uids.clear();
1077:     indent = 1;
1078:     std::function<void(const aiNode*)> visit_node_geo = [&](const aiNode *node) {
1079:         if (node->mNumMeshes == 0) {
1080:           for (uint32_t ni = 0; ni < node->mNumChildren; ni++) {
1081:             visit_node_geo(node->mChildren[ni]);
1082:           }
1083:           return;
1084:         }
1085: 
1086:         // start the node record
1087:         FBX::Node n("Geometry");
1088:         int64_t uid = generate_uid();
1089:         mesh_uids[node] = uid;
1090:         n.AddProperty(uid);
1091:         n.AddProperty(FBX::SEPARATOR + "Geometry");
1092:         n.AddProperty("Mesh");
1093:         n.Begin(outstream, binary, indent);
1094:         n.DumpProperties(outstream, binary, indent);
1095:         n.EndProperties(outstream, binary, indent);
1096:         n.BeginChildren(outstream, binary, indent);
1097: 
1098:         // output vertex data - each vertex should be unique (probably)
1099:         std::vector<double> flattened_vertices;
1100:         // index of original vertex in vertex data vector
1101:         std::vector<int32_t> vertex_indices;
1102: 
1103:         std::vector<double> normal_data;
1104:         std::vector<double> color_data;
1105: 
1106:         std::vector<int32_t> polygon_data;
1107: 
1108:         std::vector<std::vector<double>> uv_data;
1109:         std::vector<std::vector<int32_t>> uv_indices;
1110:         std::map<aiVector3D, int32_t> index_by_uv;
1111: 
1112:         std::vector<int32_t> offsets = { 0 };
1113: 
1114:         indent = 2;
1115: 
1116:         for (uint32_t n_mi = 0; n_mi < node->mNumMeshes; n_mi++) {
1117:           const auto mi = node->mMeshes[n_mi];
1118:           const aiMesh *m = mScene->mMeshes[mi];
1119: 
1120:           size_t v_offset = vertex_indices.size();
1121:           size_t uniq_v_before = flattened_vertices.size() / 3;
1122: 
1123:           // map of vertex value to its index in the data vector
1124:           std::map<aiVector3D,size_t> index_by_vertex_value;
1125:           if(bJoinIdenticalVertices){
1126:               int32_t index = 0;
1127:               for (size_t vi = 0; vi < m->mNumVertices; ++vi) {
1128:                   aiVector3D vtx = m->mVertices[vi];
1129:                   auto elem = index_by_vertex_value.find(vtx);
1130:                   if (elem == index_by_vertex_value.end()) {
1131:                       vertex_indices.push_back(index);
1132:                       index_by_vertex_value[vtx] = index;
1133:                       flattened_vertices.insert(flattened_vertices.end(), { vtx.x, vtx.y, vtx.z });
1134:                       ++index;
1135:                   } else {
1136:                       vertex_indices.push_back(int32_t(elem->second));
1137:                   }
1138:               }
1139:           } else { // do not join vertex, respect the export flag
1140:               vertex_indices.resize(v_offset + m->mNumVertices);
1141:               std::iota(vertex_indices.begin() + v_offset, vertex_indices.end(), (int)v_offset);
1142:               for(unsigned int v = 0; v < m->mNumVertices; ++ v) {
1143:                   aiVector3D vtx = m->mVertices[v];
1144:                   flattened_vertices.insert(flattened_vertices.end(), {vtx.x, vtx.y, vtx.z});
1145:               }
1146:           }
1147:           vVertexIndice[mi].insert(
1148:             // TODO test whether this can be end or not
1149:             vVertexIndice[mi].begin(),
1150:             vertex_indices.begin(),
1151:             vertex_indices.end()
1152:           );
1153: 
1154:           // here could be edges but they're insane.
1155:           // it's optional anyway, so let's ignore it.
1156: 
1157:         // output polygon data as a flattened array of vertex indices.
1158:         // the last vertex index of each polygon is negated and - 1
1159:           for (size_t fi = 0; fi < m->mNumFaces; fi++) {
1160:             const aiFace &f = m->mFaces[fi];
1161:             size_t pvi = 0;
1162:             for (; pvi < f.mNumIndices - 1; pvi++) {
1163:               polygon_data.push_back(
1164:                 static_cast<int32_t>(uniq_v_before + vertex_indices[v_offset + f.mIndices[pvi]])
1165:               );
1166:             }
1167:             polygon_data.push_back(
1168:               static_cast<int32_t>(-1 - (uniq_v_before + vertex_indices[v_offset+f.mIndices[pvi]]))
1169:             );
1170:           }
1171: 
1172:           uniq_v_before_mi.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(uniq_v_before));
1173: 
1174:           if (m->HasNormals()) {
1175:             normal_data.reserve(3 * polygon_data.size());
1176:             for (size_t fi = 0; fi < m->mNumFaces; fi++) {
1177:               const aiFace & f = m->mFaces[fi];

1828:     // bones.
1829:     //
1830:     // output structure:
1831:     // subset of node hierarchy that are "skeleton",
1832:     // i.e. do not have meshes but only bones.
1833:     // but.. i'm not sure how anyone could guarantee that...
1834:     //
1835:     // input...
1836:     // well, for each mesh it has "bones",
1837:     // and the bone names correspond to nodes.
1838:     // of course we also need the parent nodes,
1839:     // as they give some of the transform........
1840:     //
1841:     // well. we can assume a sane input, i suppose.
1842:     //
1843:     // so input is the bone node hierarchy,
1844:     // with an extra thing for the transformation of the MESH in BONE space.
1845:     //
1846:     // output is a set of bone nodes,
1847:     // a "bindpose" which indicates the default local transform of all bones,
1848:     // and a set of "deformers".
1849:     // each deformer is parented to a mesh geometry,
1850:     // and has one or more "subdeformer"s as children.
1851:     // each subdeformer has one bone node as a child,
1852:     // and represents the influence of that bone on the grandparent mesh.
1853:     // the subdeformer has a list of indices, and weights,
1854:     // with indices specifying vertex indices,
1855:     // and weights specifying the corresponding influence of this bone.
1856:     // it also has Transform and TransformLink elements,
1857:     // specifying the transform of the MESH in BONE space,
1858:     // and the transformation of the BONE in WORLD space,
1859:     // likely in the bindpose.
1860:     //
1861:     // the input bone structure is different but similar,
1862:     // storing the number of weights for this bone,
1863:     // and an array of (vertex index, weight) pairs.
1864:     //
1865:     // one sticky point is that the number of vertices may not match,
1866:     // because assimp splits vertices by normal, uv, etc.
1867: 
1868: 
1869:     // first we should mark the skeleton for each mesh.
1870:     // the skeleton must include not only the aiBones,
1871:     // but also all their parent nodes.
1872:     // anything that affects the position of any bone node must be included.
1873: 
1874:     // note that we want to preserve input order as much as possible here.
1875:     // previously, sorting by name lead to consistent output across systems, but was not
1876:     // suitable for downstream consumption by some applications.
1877:     std::vector<std::vector<const aiNode*>> skeleton_by_mesh(mScene->mNumMeshes);
1878:     // at the same time we can build a list of all the skeleton nodes,
1879:     // which will be used later to mark them as type "limbNode".
1880:     std::unordered_set<const aiNode*> limbnodes;
1881: 
1882:     //actual bone nodes in fbx, without parenting-up
1883:     std::vector<std::string> allBoneNames;
1884:     for(unsigned int m = 0; m < mScene->mNumMeshes; ++ m) {
1885:         aiMesh* pMesh = mScene->mMeshes[m];
1886:         for(unsigned int b = 0; b < pMesh->mNumBones; ++ b)
1887:             allBoneNames.push_back(pMesh->mBones[b]->mName.data);
1888:     }
1889:     aiMatrix4x4 mxTransIdentity;
1890: 
1891:     // and a map of nodes by bone name, as finding them is annoying.
1892:     std::map<std::string,aiNode*> node_by_bone;
1893:     for (size_t mi = 0; mi < mScene->mNumMeshes; ++mi) {
1894:         const aiMesh* m = mScene->mMeshes[mi];
1895:         std::vector<const aiNode*> skeleton;
1896:         for (size_t bi =0; bi < m->mNumBones; ++bi) {
1897:             const aiBone* b = m->mBones[bi];
1898:             const std::string name(b->mName.C_Str());
1899:             auto elem = node_by_bone.find(name);
1900:             aiNode* n;
1901:             if (elem != node_by_bone.end()) {
1902:                 n = elem->second;
1903:             } else {
1904:                 n = mScene->mRootNode->FindNode(b->mName);
1905:                 if (!n) {
1906:                     // this should never happen
1907:                     std::stringstream err;
1908:                     err << "Failed to find node for bone: \"" << name << "\"";
1909:                     throw DeadlyExportError(err.str());
1910:                 }
1911:                 node_by_bone[name] = n;
1912:                 limbnodes.insert(n);
1913:             }
1914:             skeleton.push_back(n);
1915:             // mark all parent nodes as skeleton as well,
1916:             // up until we find the root node,
1917:             // or else the node containing the mesh,
1918:             // or else the parent of a node containing the mesh.
1919:             for (
1920:                 const aiNode* parent = n->mParent;
1921:                 parent && parent != mScene->mRootNode;
1922:                 parent = parent->mParent
1923:             ) {
1924:                 // if we've already done this node we can skip it all
1925:                 if (std::find(skeleton.begin(), skeleton.end(), parent) != skeleton.end()) {
1926:                     break;
1927:                 }
1928:                 // ignore fbx transform nodes as these will be collapsed later
1929:                 // TODO: cache this by aiNode*
1930:                 const std::string node_name(parent->mName.C_Str());
1931:                 if (node_name.find(MAGIC_NODE_TAG) != std::string::npos) {
1932:                     continue;
1933:                 }
1934:                 //not a bone in scene && no effect in transform
1935:                 if (std::find(allBoneNames.begin(), allBoneNames.end(), node_name) == allBoneNames.end()
1936:                    && parent->mTransformation == mxTransIdentity) {
1937:                         continue;
1938:                 }
1939:                 // otherwise check if this is the root of the skeleton
1940:                 bool end = false;
1941:                 // is the mesh part of this node?
1942:                 for (size_t i = 0; i < parent->mNumMeshes && !end; ++i) {
1943:                     end |= parent->mMeshes[i] == mi;
1944:                 }
1945:                 // is the mesh in one of the children of this node?
1946:                 for (size_t j = 0; j < parent->mNumChildren && !end; ++j) {
1947:                     aiNode* child = parent->mChildren[j];
1948:                     for (size_t i = 0; i < child->mNumMeshes && !end; ++i) {
1949:                         end |= child->mMeshes[i] == mi;
1950:                     }
1951:                 }
1952: 
1953:                 // if it was the skeleton root we can finish here
1954:                 if (end) { break; }
1955:             }
1956:         }
1957:         skeleton_by_mesh[mi] = skeleton;
1958:     }
1959: 
1960:     // we'll need the uids for the bone nodes, so generate them now
1961:     for (size_t i = 0; i < mScene->mNumMeshes; ++i) {
1962:         auto &s = skeleton_by_mesh[i];
1963:         for (const aiNode* n : s) {
1964:             if (node_uids.find(n) == node_uids.end()) {
1965:                 node_uids[n] = generate_uid();
1966:             }
1967:         }
1968:     }
1969: 
1970:     // now, for each aiMesh, we need to export a deformer,
1971:     // and for each aiBone a subdeformer,
1972:     // which should have all the skinning info.
1973:     // these will need to be connected properly to the mesh,
1974:     // and we can do that all now.
1975:     for (size_t mi = 0; mi < mScene->mNumMeshes; ++mi) {
1976:         const aiMesh* m = mScene->mMeshes[mi];
1977:         if (!m->HasBones()) {
1978:             continue;
1979:         }
1980: 
1981:         const aiNode *mesh_node = get_node_for_mesh((uint32_t)mi, mScene->mRootNode);
1982:         // make a deformer for this mesh
1983:         int64_t deformer_uid = generate_uid();
1984:         FBX::Node dnode("Deformer");
1985:         dnode.AddProperties(deformer_uid, FBX::SEPARATOR + "Deformer", "Skin");
1986:         dnode.AddChild("Version", int32_t(101));
1987:         // "acuracy"... this is not a typo....
1988:         dnode.AddChild("Link_DeformAcuracy", double(50));
1989:         dnode.AddChild("SkinningType", "Linear"); // TODO: other modes?
1990:         dnode.Dump(outstream, binary, indent);
1991: 
1992:         // connect it
1993:         connections.emplace_back("C", "OO", deformer_uid, mesh_uids[mesh_node]);
1994: 
1995:         // TODO, FIXME: this won't work if anything is not in the bind pose.
1996:         // for now if such a situation is detected, we throw an exception.
1997:         std::set<const aiBone*> not_in_bind_pose;
1998:         std::set<const aiNode*> no_offset_matrix;
1999: 
2000:         // first get this mesh's position in world space,
2001:         // as we'll need it for each subdeformer.
2002:         //
2003:         // ...of course taking the position of the MESH doesn't make sense,
2004:         // as it can be instanced to many nodes.
2005:         // All we can do is assume no instancing,
2006:         // and take the first node we find that contains the mesh.
2007:         aiMatrix4x4 mesh_xform = get_world_transform(mesh_node, mScene);
2008: 
2009:         // now make a subdeformer for each bone in the skeleton
2010:         const auto & skeleton= skeleton_by_mesh[mi];
2011:         for (const aiNode* bone_node : skeleton) {
2012:             // if there's a bone for this node, find it
2013:             const aiBone* b = nullptr;
2014:             for (size_t bi = 0; bi < m->mNumBones; ++bi) {
2015:                 // TODO: this probably should index by something else
2016:                 const std::string name(m->mBones[bi]->mName.C_Str());
2017:                 if (node_by_bone[name] == bone_node) {
2018:                     b = m->mBones[bi];
2019:                     break;
2020:                 }
2021:             }
2022:             if (!b) {
2023:                 no_offset_matrix.insert(bone_node);
2024:             }
2025: 
2026:             // start the subdeformer node
2027:             const int64_t subdeformer_uid = generate_uid();
2028:             FBX::Node sdnode("Deformer");
2029:             sdnode.AddProperties(
2030:                 subdeformer_uid, FBX::SEPARATOR + "SubDeformer", "Cluster"
2031:             );
2032:             sdnode.AddChild("Version", int32_t(100));
2033:             sdnode.AddChild("UserData", "", "");
2034: 
2035:             // add indices and weights, if any
2036:             if (b) {
2037:                 std::set<int32_t> setWeightedVertex;
2038:                 std::vector<int32_t> subdef_indices;
2039:                 std::vector<double> subdef_weights;
2040:                 int32_t last_index = -1;
2041:                 for (size_t wi = 0; wi < b->mNumWeights; ++wi) {
2042:                     int32_t vi = vVertexIndice[mi][b->mWeights[wi].mVertexId] \
2043:                       + uniq_v_before_mi[mi];
2044:                     bool bIsWeightedAlready = (setWeightedVertex.find(vi) != setWeightedVertex.end());
2045:                     if (vi == last_index || bIsWeightedAlready) {
2046:                         // only for vertices we exported to fbx
2047:                         // TODO, FIXME: this assumes identically-located vertices
2048:                         // will always deform in the same way.
2049:                         // as assimp doesn't store a separate list of "positions",
2050:                         // there's not much that can be done about this
2051:                         // other than assuming that identical position means
2052:                         // identical vertex.
2053:                         continue;
2054:                     }
2055:                     setWeightedVertex.insert(vi);
2056:                     subdef_indices.push_back(vi);
2057:                     subdef_weights.push_back(b->mWeights[wi].mWeight);
2058:                     last_index = vi;
2059:                 }
2060:                 // yes, "indexes"
2061:                 sdnode.AddChild("Indexes", subdef_indices);
2062:                 sdnode.AddChild("Weights", subdef_weights);
2063:             }
2064: 
2065:             // transform is the transform of the mesh, but in bone space.
2066:             // if the skeleton is in the bind pose,
2067:             // we can take the inverse of the world-space bone transform
2068:             // and multiply by the world-space transform of the mesh.
2069:             aiMatrix4x4 bone_xform = get_world_transform(bone_node, mScene);
2070:             aiMatrix4x4 inverse_bone_xform = bone_xform;
2071:             inverse_bone_xform.Inverse();
2072:             aiMatrix4x4 tr = inverse_bone_xform * mesh_xform;
2073: 
2074:             sdnode.AddChild("Transform", tr);
2075: 
2076: 
2077:             sdnode.AddChild("TransformLink", bone_xform);
2078:             // note: this means we ALWAYS rely on the mesh node transform
2079:             // being unchanged from the time the skeleton was bound.
2080:             // there's not really any way around this at the moment.
2081: 
2082:             // done
2083:             sdnode.Dump(outstream, binary, indent);
2084: 
2085:             // lastly, connect to the parent deformer
2086:             connections.emplace_back(
2087:                 "C", "OO", subdeformer_uid, deformer_uid
2088:             );
2089: 
2090:             // we also need to connect the limb node to the subdeformer.
2091:             connections.emplace_back(
2092:                 "C", "OO", node_uids[bone_node], subdeformer_uid
2093:             );
2094:         }
2095: 
2096:         // if we cannot create a valid FBX file, simply die.
2097:         // this will both prevent unnecessary bug reports,
2098:         // and tell the user what they can do to fix the situation
2099:         // (i.e. export their model in the bind pose).
2100:         if (no_offset_matrix.size() && not_in_bind_pose.size()) {
2101:             std::stringstream err;
2102:             err << "Not enough information to construct bind pose";
2103:             err << " for mesh " << mi << "!";

2116:             err << " Please ensure bones are in the bind pose to export.";

2118:         }
